newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares poised to rise after U.S. rally.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares poised to rise after U.S. rally.

text.p: Danish share prices rose in early trade in a nervous market on Tuesday with dealers predicting a day of solid recovery ahead on the back of the Wall Street rally, stable bonds and a strong dollar.
"There is still rather a jittery mood, but the recovery in the U.S. should trigger advances here with the KFX index set to climb one percentage point by the end of play," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had gained 0.77 point or 0.43 percent to 181.63 at 0740 GMT, having closed 1.13 point lower on Monday.
